snippet.title: Blighted - Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
Battle your way through a psychedelic western nightmare to reclaim the memories of your people in Blighted, an action RPG from the creators of Guacamelee! and Nobody Saves the World. Harness the power of the deadly, reality-altering Blight and unravel the mysteries of a twisted world.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2974160/Blighted/
More info: https://blightedgame.com/
